# Configuring log levels for cert-manager and the {{ cert_manager_operator }} {#cert-manager-log-levels}

To troubleshoot issues with the cert-manager components and the {{ cert_manager_operator }}, you can configure the log level verbosity.

> [!NOTE]
> To use different log levels for different cert-manager components, see *Customizing cert-manager Operator API fields*.

## Additional resources {#cert-manager-log-levels_additional-resources}
